annotations.title: Import links from an existing bio page

description: Read an existing Linktree, Beacons, Carrd or bio page URL and extract its suggested name, bio, handle, social icons and link buttons so the user can migrate in seconds. Read-only: saves nothing until you call links_save after confirmation.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

url.description: The public https:// address of an existing Linktree, Beacons, Carrd or bio page to read (such as "https://linktr.ee/yourname"). Read-only: returns suggested name, bio, social icons and links without saving.

name: links_import
title: Import links from an existing bio page
